description: Projects how a league table could finish, from the matches left and the Desk's line forecasts. It gives each team's likely place, its chance to finish first and, when the Desk knows the playoff cut, its chance to make the playoffs. It also says what the named team needs, while a Desk Pass adds the team's live playoff report. Call it for a team's playoff chances or what it needs. Pass the team, or `league` and `area` for a whole league, or neither for the member's own team. Needs a Desk Pass. Without one, a call gets the free part, with no chance in it, and `deskPass`, whose `message` you give the person.

area.description: The area of that league, e.g. 'Marin'. Used only with `league`.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

league.description: A league to project when no team is named, with its words, e.g. "55 & over men's 8.0". Used only without `team`.

team.description: The team whose league to project, e.g. 'Belvedere men's 7.5'. Omit for the signed-in member's own team. Or the team's Desk page link or number.

name: project_standings
title: How a league could finish
